evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "Standards", "maintainable models", "GDPR-sensitive", "governance" dominate. No mention of speed, MVP, or rapid iteration; "No mention of speed, MVP, or rapid iteration" is explicitly noted as conspicuously absent.
evidence.domain_risk: "Experience working with GDPR-sensitive data" is a hard requirement. Mentimeter handles user behavioural and interaction data across a global user base — GDPR violations carry legal and reputational risk.
evidence.jd_authorship: Technical hiring manager authorship: "Design, own, and evolve core data models and the modelling architecture" is architect-level language. "Experience with a semantic layer or metrics layer" and "Experience using AI-assisted coding or coding agents in a disciplined way (reviews, tests, documentation)" are practitioner-level qualifiers rarely written by generalist recruiters.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Design, own, and evolve core data models" and "Build standards, documentation, and data catalogs for the organization" imply these do not yet exist — primarily a greenfield/establish effort rather than scaling or fixing inherited systems.
evidence.data_team_maturity: "Build standards, documentation, and data catalogs for the organization" implies these do not yet exist — early maturity signal. "Design, own, and evolve core data models" with no mention of peers doing the same implies this person is the primary or sole analytics engineering owner.
evidence.collaboration_width: Teams and functions referenced verbatim: "business and technical stakeholders" (paired group), "sales" analytics, "marketing" analytics, "product" analytics. "Partner with business and technical stakeholders from problem framing to shipped artefacts" spans multiple business functions.
evidence.language_gate: "Communication in English with both technical and non-technical audiences" is listed under Required Qualifications. No other language requirement stated.
evidence.urgency: No urgency language detected. Posting reads as a planned, deliberate hire — implies they are willing to wait for the right person.
